semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in vacuum measurement technology critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shanghai CHUNY Measurement Technology Co., Ltd. designs and manufactures high-precision vacuum gauges essential for vacuum measurement in semiconductor fabrication. Their solutions cater to equipment manufacturers and end-users across various sectors, including semiconductors, where accurate vacuum measurement is vital for process control and quality assurance.

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Shanghai, specifically in the Qidi Science and Technology Park.
